verdict.rationale: Brex documents that AI assistants file employee reimbursements automatically (brex-docs-23) and that reimbursements are paid to local bank accounts to speed up payment (brex-docs-44). A review agent auto-approves low-risk expenses (brex-docs-16), and receipts can be uploaded and matched (brex-docs-27). However, the core out-of-pocket flow is only glancingly described, missing for 10: an explicit out-of-pocket expense submission flow, direct-deposit payout timing (reimbursed in days), status tracking from submission to payout, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
